question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exagerate"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Exaggerate"**. The word "Exagerate" does not exist in the English language. (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example:** "She tends to exagerate her achievements during conversations." (Incorrect usage)
 
 
• **"Exaggerate"** means to represent something as being larger, greater, or more extreme than it actually is. (बढ़ा-चढ़ा कर बताना)
 
 
• **Example:** "He exaggerated the number of people who attended the event to make it seem more successful." (Correct usage)
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unnecessary** (अनावश्यक): Not needed or required.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting was unnecessary since the issue was already resolved.
 
 
 
• **Argument** (तर्क, बहस): A discussion in which different opinions are expressed.
 
 
• **Example:** Their argument about politics lasted for hours.
 
 
 
• **Misinterpret** (गलत अर्थ निकालना): To understand or explain something incorrectly.
 
 
• **Example:** She misinterpreted his silence as disapproval.
